definitions.explanation: Waste material that is thrown away. Includes household waste, litter, and any discarded items.

examples.japanese: ゴミを{出|だ}してきます。
examples.english: I'll go take out the trash.
examples.notes: ゴミを出す = to take out the trash

examples.japanese: ゴミは{分|わ}けてください。
examples.notes: Garbage sorting is important in Japan

examples.japanese: ここにゴミを{捨|す}てないでください。

notes: Usually written in katakana as ゴミ, but can also be written as ごみ in hiragana or {塵|ごみ} in kanji. In Japan, trash must often be sorted into categories: {燃|も}えるゴミ (burnable), {燃|も}えないゴミ (non-burnable), and recyclables.
